Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached an optometrist and a truck driver about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The optometrist got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the truck driver scored well and was selected. Who is unintelligent?
A. The optometrist
B. The truck driver
C. Cannot be determined
